rules.rationale: Base equation defining the structural helper tailIS on the empty IntSeq; it introduces the named proof term's empty case rather than asserting an independent fact about program execution.
Constructor equation defining tailIS on a nonempty IntSeq by selecting its tail; together with the empty case it is the structural definition of the helper.
Guarded defining equation for overlapCount when the pattern is empty, assigning the boundary-count branch of the mathematical summary.
Guarded base equation for overlapCount on an empty source and a nonempty pattern; it is one disjoint case of the summary definition.
Guarded recursive equation defining overlapCount for nonempty source and pattern values by testing the current prefix and recurring on tailIS.

This simplification rule adds the mathematical slice-to-tail fact needed by symbolic proof. prove.sh never first proves its exact statement in a rule-free module, and PROOF.md records that the separate bridge-free attempt exited 1, so it is trusted rather than PROVED_DERIVED_LEMMA.
